Name: Beach Farm Remastered
Author: pluviophist
Description:
[center][color=#e69138][size=5][font=Courier New]Welcome to Beach Farm Remastered![/font][/size][/color][/center]
[center][font=Times New Roman]This map is the successor to my very first modded farm, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24235]Beach Farm Redone[/url]. Featuring green (tillable) pastures, vast sandy banks, rocky tide pools, vibrant tropical thickets, minecarts and warps, a custom farm cave, and a swimmable ocean![/font][/center]
[center].[/center]
[center][font=Times New Roman][b]There are two download options: Vanilla beach farm replacement, or a new farm type. [u]Only download one[/u].[/b] [/font][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][line]
[/center]
[center][font=Times New Roman][img width=600,height=600]https://i.imgur.com/uIQYM7r.gif[/img][/font][/center]
[center][line]
[/center]
[left][color=#6d9eeb][size=4][font=Times New Roman]✿[b] Config Options:[/b][/font][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][font=Times New Roman]TWO versions of the map: Standard, and Clean [[i]removes thickets, crop field sections, and minor decor[/i]]. [b]Both options are available in the config settings[/b]. [/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Ocean ambience will play on the farm map [[i]and in the custom farm cave[/i]], similar to the Pelican Town beach. [b]This can be turned off in the config settings[/b].[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]The central saltwater pond and eastern tide pools can also be toggled [b]in the config settings[/b].[/font][/*]
[/list][/left]
[left][color=#76a5af][size=4][font=Times New Roman]✿ [b]Map Features:[/b][/font][/size][/color][/left]
[left][list]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Custom crop fields with markings [[i]optional[/i]][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Custom farm cave, themed as a hidden beach cove  [[/font][font=Times New Roman][i]optional[/i]][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]The shores will yield ocean fish by fishing and crab pots, while the eastern freshwater stream [[i]leading to the waterfall[/i]] will yield river fish[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Hidden space for silos in the very top-right corner of the map [[i]check images for reference[/i]][/font][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Renewable hardwood stumps[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Starter mango tree [[i]if this bothers you, just cut it down..[/i]][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Minecarts located on the northeast corner of the farm [[i]you must complete the minecart bundle[/i]], and in the farm cave [[i]if custom cave is enabled[/i]][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Sign warps to provide fast travel around the farm[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Beach forage and crates will spawn on all sand banks like normal[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]All "shallow" sections of the ocean are accessible by the player[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]An open and swimmable ocean, accessed by the dock on the southern edge of the map or by ladder next to the eastern waterfall[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Replaces the [u][b]Beach Farm[/b][/u] farm map, or adds a [b][u]New Farm Type[/u][/b][/font][/*]
[/list]
[list]
[*][font=Times New Roman][color=#cc0000][size=4]NOTE[/size][/color]: The thickets of trees found around the map are functional trees that can be tapped, cut, and replanted. To keep the spreading of trees under control, the tiles surrounding and within the thickets will NOT spawn trees, and no more can be planted [[i]other than in place of an existing tree[/i]]. This does not include fruit trees, which can be planted in the thickets, so long as the surrounding tiles are clear. Trees will grow and spread in the open meadows like normal. [/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]This feature is disabled on the [b]clean [/b]version of the map.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][color=#cc0000][size=4]NOTE[/size][/color]:  [[i]Only if using the replacement version[/i]] If playing with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn[/url], there is a Farm_Island.tmx file which will overwrite my mod and cause Beach Farm Remastered not to show up. A simple fix for now is to remove the Farm_Island.tmx in VPR [[i]console warnings will appear, but game operates normally[/i]][/font][/*]
[/list][/left]
[font=Times New Roman][color=#93c47d][size=4]✿[b] Installation:[/b][/size][/color][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098?tab=description]Generic Mod Config[/url]﻿ [Optional, but makes configuration easier][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]DaisyNiko's Tilsheets[/url]﻿﻿[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Download this mod[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Unzip the mod into your Stardew Valley "Mods/" folder[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Run the game using SMAPI[/font][/*]
[/list]
[list]
[*][font=Times New Roman]To uninstall, delete this mod from Mods folder[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Times New Roman]
[size=4]✿ [b]Enjoy the map, and please let me know if you come across any issues[/b]. ฅ(^•ﻌ•^ฅ) ♡[/size]

Mods Used in Screenshots[/font]
[list]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Map/Foliage Recolor: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn[/url] [ + VPR Expanded in optional files ], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4966]Stardew Foliage Redone[/url],  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15079?tab=description]Better Water[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8897]Visible Fish[/url] [/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Buildings: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16615]Ghibli Style Furniture[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9704?tab=files]Seasonal Japanese Buildings[/url][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Items: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47265]Spouse Patio Pathing[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5513]Gwen's Medieval Craftables[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24980]Modular Garden Pots[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16029]Nano's Retro Style Furniture[/url][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]﻿Reshade: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1213]Natural Color[/url][/font][/*]
[/list]
